entries.name: x402 Trustlayer Escrow
entries.description: Agent-to-agent escrow payments with a trust/settlement layer over x402.

usage.callShape: POST https://x402trustlayer.xyz/api/agent-escrow with JSON body {action, payerAgentId, payeeAgentId, amountUsdc, releaseCondition} (x402 payment $0.12 USDC on Base/Polygon/Solana)
usage.outputShape: Expected (per outputSchema, NOT observed): body.ok, body.allowed, body.summary, body.confidence, body.checks_passed[]. Actual response was an error: body.error, body.reason.
quirks: Endpoint's own x402 facilitator returned facilitator_error_500: 'Timed out while waiting for transaction' - settlement could not complete.
Response was HTTP 402 with paid:false / costUsd:0; the submitted tx hash never landed on-chain (receipt = null), so no USDC was actually lost on the failed attempt.
Required body fields (all): action, payerAgentId, payeeAgentId, amountUsdc, releaseCondition. None of these need a real-world recipient - they are agent IDs + an escrow condition string.
Accepts payment on eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:137 (Polygon), and Solana mainnet, all $0.12 USDC.
usage.guide: This agent-to-agent escrow trust-layer endpoint is currently BROKEN: the provider's own x402 facilitator times out during settlement (facilitator_error_500), returning HTTP 402 without completing payment. Do not rely on it. If retested and working, POST to https://x402trustlayer.xyz/api/agent-escrow with JSON {action, payerAgentId, payeeAgentId, amountUsdc, releaseCondition} and pay $0.12 USDC via x402; read the trust evaluation from body.allowed / body.summary / body.confidence / body.checks_passed[]. Because settlement failed on the only attempt, no charge occurred (tx never confirmed on-chain).

entries.name: Molty.cash Tip / Hire
entries.description: Send USDC tips or hire/pay agents and people via Molty.cash.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.molty.cash/{username}/a2a — JSON-RPC 2.0 body {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tip"|"hire","params":{"amount":<USDC 0.01-10>,"description":"...","identity_token":"<Molty JWT>"}}. The {username} path segment is the X (Twitter) handle of the recipient; the registry URL hardcodes it to "web3idan".
quirks: OUTWARD/IRREVERSIBLE: actually sends USDC. The x402 fee (~$0.02) is SEPARATE from and ON TOP OF the params.amount tip (min 0.01 USDC) it forwards.

Recipient is set by the URL path segment {username} = an X/Twitter handle, NOT by the body. Registry URL fixes it to 'web3idan'. To tip a different person you must change the path segment to their X handle.
Body is JSON-RPC 2.0: requires jsonrpc='2.0', method ('tip' or 'hire'), and params; params.amount is required (0.01-10). 'hire' additionally needs params.description.
params.identity_token is a Molty identity JWT to attribute the sender; not auto-provided by the x402 wallet and may be required for proper sender attribution.
Could not pay-test: the fixed recipient (web3idan) is not the QA verifiable contact, so receipt cannot be confirmed.

APPROVAL-GATED: this is an OUTWARD/irreversible action (real charge / order / shipment). Shape is from the provider OpenAPI/discovery and was NOT QA-executed (we do not place real bookings/purchases as tests). The needsApproval gate fires before any real execution.
DEAD 2026-06-11: De-scoped (ash 2026-06-11) — not wanted in the registry.
needs: A recipient X (Twitter) handle to substitute into the {username} path segment that maps to the verifiable QA contact (John Doe), since the registry URL hardcodes 'web3idan' and the tip cannot otherwise be confirmed received
A Molty identity_token (JWT) for sender attribution, if required
usage.guide: This is an outward money-movement endpoint: it sends a real USDC tip (or funds a hire task) to an X/Twitter handle, charging both an x402 service fee and the tip amount. Set the recipient by putting their X handle in the URL path segment (the registry URL fixes it to https://api.molty.cash/web3idan/a2a). POST a JSON-RPC 2.0 body: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tip","params":{"amount":0.01}} for a tip, or method "hire" with params.description for a task; optionally include params.identity_token (a Molty JWT) to identify the sender. On success read body.result.receipt for the receipt URL and body.result.payment_request_id. Always confirm the recipient X handle and amount before paying — it is irreversible.

entries.name: Cross-Border Payments
entries.description: Cross-border payments and banking rails via x402.

quirks: Host expansion.402box.io resolves via DNS to 172.104.233.24 (Linode) but accepts NO TCP connections on port 443 or 80 — every connect times out.
No 402 payment quote is obtainable; the server is effectively down/unreachable.
qa-pay returned classification=wallet-error, paid=false, error='provider request failed: fetch failed' — this is a network/host failure, not a wallet problem.
Endpoint is marked outward/irreversible (banking setup) but cannot be reached to test.
usage.guide: This endpoint is currently dead. The host expansion.402box.io resolves in DNS but does not accept connections on 443/80 (all connects time out), so no request — paid or unpaid — completes. No USDC was spent. Do not attempt to call it until the provider host is confirmed back online; if it returns, it is an outward/irreversible 'banking setup' action that needs human approval before any paid call.
